summary: BridgeBio Pharma filed a Form 8-K revealing entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Goldman Sachs and Leerink Partners for an at-the-market offering of up to $500M in common stock. The ATM program allows the company to sell shares on a best-efforts basis on Nasdaq; no minimum sales obligation exists. Commissions are up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is routine capital raising, not a special situation.
